prompt: Provide a description of a safety-critical scenario where the ego vehicle is changing lanes. The adversarial agent (pedestrian, car, cyclist, or motorcycle) should perform an unexpected behavior that may lead to a collision. Keep it to one or two short sentences.
descriptions: As the ego vehicle initiates a lane change into the left lane, a motorcycle unexpectedly drifts into the path of the changing lane, forcing an immediate evasive maneuver.
The ego vehicle initiates a lane change to the right; simultaneously, a cyclist abruptly drifts into the ego vehicle's path attempting to avoid an unseen obstacle.
While executing a left lane change, a cyclist suddenly swerves across the path of the ego vehicle to avoid an unseen obstacle.
While changing from the right lane to the middle lane, a cyclist unexpectedly drifts into the ego vehicle's path, forcing an immediate emergency braking maneuver.
An autonomous vehicle attempting to change lanes suddenly encounters a motorcycle drifting into its intended path, requiring immediate emergency braking.
